title: Simple Glossary

items.def: Lying close and flat against, as hairs against a surface.
The angle formed by a leaf or branch with the stem.
Twice pinnately compound; the primary leaflets being further divided into secondary leaflets.
The collective term for all the sepals of a flower.
The collective term for all of the petals of a flower.
A fleshy fruit, surrounding a stone that contains a single seed.
Tiny thin scales enclosing a grass grain, often having hairlike appendages to assist with wind and animal dispersal of the seed.
Raised pores or short lines on the stems of plants, usually corky in color.
A tiny membranous projection often fringed with hairs, from the summit of the sheath of grasses, located in the *uxil*.
A loose irregularly branched inflorescence (flower cluster).
